# Retained Ultra2 source-only recipes

This is the active, pre-native source manifest. It preserves all 32 input packets
from the initial campaign and changes exactly two publication hypotheses: uniform
first blocks of eight/nine bytes are compressed. Thirty complete state predictions
are inherited unchanged from the successful, source-bound initial campaign; the
two corrected cases are replayed under both ordinary and optimized Python.

The corpus retains all 21 previous policy-2 input/schedule identities, includes
first/later seven/eight/nine-byte thresholds, non-power-of-two first-block rebases,
three/four-block boundaries, 32768-byte frames, short-key searches, later horizons,
alternative selection/rejection and raw/RLE/compressed publication hypotheses.
The active manifest predicts 229,657 events and
572 later-block alternatives per padding run. Full sparse
path, search and frequency state persists between phases and actual blocks.

Each Python mode rejects sixteen coherent later-phase forgeries, checks six
threshold cases and verifies that two future-source mutations leave all first-block
seed/encoding observations unchanged. No codec or child process executes in these
checks. Actual native publication remains a separate required audit.

The source-bound campaigns, both Python modes, initial and corrected manifests,
controllers, outputs and independent model binding are retained in
`docs/evidence/2026-10-22-ultra2-retained-recipes.{json,tar.gz}`.
